exportScopeHint: Scope = user-level global configuration (usr store): LLM definitions, toolchain paths, timeouts and retries, default LLM and scenario, theme and language, tool async / sandbox, recent projects. MCP definitions (four-level file-based configuration, see the MCP settings page), project-level configuration, sessions and memory data are not included.
exportSecretWarn: ⚠ The exported content contains sensitive data such as API keys (LLM apiKey). Keep the file safe and never upload it to a public place.
excludeSecretsHint: Included by default (for full migration); when checked, secret fields are removed from the exported file.
currentSummary: {keys} configuration entries in total, {secrets} secret fields among them.
exportDownloaded: Host file dialog is unavailable (browser form) → the file was downloaded instead; check your browser downloads folder.
importHint: Choose an exported JSON file or paste JSON content. Import merges by overriding keys (only keys present in the file are written) and never clears other settings; the current configuration is backed up before importing.
importEmpty: Content is empty. Choose a file or paste JSON.
importBadJson: The file is not valid JSON and cannot be parsed.
importBadShape: The JSON is not a configuration object (expected an object keyed by configuration keys).
importNoKeys: No importable configuration keys found ({count} unknown keys ignored).
importReadFailed: Failed to read the file, please retry.
importConfirmBody: {count} keys will be overwritten: {keys}. For llms the whole list is replaced by the file definitions; other keys are only changed individually and everything else stays untouched. The current configuration is backed up first.
importRestartNote: {keys} among them take effect only after restarting the app.
importBackupDownloaded: Host file dialog is unavailable → the current configuration was downloaded as a backup instead; check your browser downloads folder.
resetScope: Clears only the user-level global configuration (usr store): theme and language, toolchain paths, timeouts and retries, default LLM and scenario, LLM definitions, tool async / sandbox and the recent projects list. Project-level configuration (prj / prjusr), MCP definitions (four-level file-based configuration), sessions and memory data are not affected.
resetConfirm1: All user-level global configuration (LLM definitions, toolchain paths, theme and language, etc.) will be cleared and this cannot be undone. Continue?
resetConfirm2: Confirm again: clear the user-level global configuration now? (the current configuration is backed up first)
